definitions.gloss: humanities and social sciences; the arts track
definitions.explanation: The group of academic fields covering literature, languages, law, economics and the like, as opposed to {理系|りけい} (sciences). Also a person who studies them.

examples.japanese: ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{文系|ぶんけい}です。
⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{文系|ぶんけい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{学部|がくぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進|すす}んだ→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: At university I went into a humanities faculty.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高校|こうこう}→高校：01083_koukou⟧⟦{二年|にねん}→二年：28862_ninen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{文系|ぶんけい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{理系|りけい}→理系：31634_rikei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{分|わ}かれる→分かれる：10976_wakareru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一般的|いっぱんてき}→一般的：04784_ippanteki⟧だ。
examples.english: Students are usually split into arts and science tracks in the second year of high school.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {文系|ぶんけい}{学部|がくぶ}: humanities and social-science faculties
- {文系|ぶんけい}⟦{科目|かもく}→科目：00163_kamoku⟧: arts subjects (Japanese, social studies, English)
- {文系|ぶんけい}⟦{出身|しゅっしん}→出身：03221_shusshin⟧: having studied in the arts track

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japanese high schools split students into {文系|ぶんけい} and ⟦{理系|りけい}→理系：31634_rikei⟧, and the choice decides which university entrance exams they take. The labels are also used for people: ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{文系|ぶんけい}だ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{数学|すうがく}→数学：01442_suugaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{苦手|にがて}→苦手：03513_nigate⟧ "I'm an arts person, so I'm bad at math."
